clips.title: The story
paras: Along the eastern road from Bloodhoof Village, Morin Cloudstalker watches over Mulgore. The tauren scout keeps an eye on trade routes and investigates threats to travelers.

Morin Cloudstalker watches the trail east toward the Barrens. He scouts the road and guards those traveling through Mulgore. The plains are usually peaceful, but trade routes and shifting territories have brought opportunists and bandits close to the tauren homeland.

Morin's scouts attacked and burned a Venture Co. caravan on Stonebull Lake's northern shore. Goblin salvagers appeared near the burned wagons, so he sent adventurers to inspect the surviving supply crates and learn what the Venture Co. had been hauling.
